female.sp: Chuchu's Demi Trainer MSJ-105CC. The two attached official front and rear images are the primary mechanical design authority. Preserve the muted olive-drab armor, dark graphite frame, off-white torso and limb panels, and bright green mono-eye and chest sensors. Preserve the asymmetry: one enormous curved slab-like olive shoulder shield rising above her LEFT shoulder and a much smaller exposed joint/armor assembly on her RIGHT shoulder. Preserve the compact round backpack with paired cylindrical housings and the pale flexible power cable running from the backpack to the rifle. She holds the complete signature extra-long dark-gray sniper beam rifle with its massive rectangular stock, long rectangular receiver, support grip and extremely long narrow barrel. Angle the rifle diagonally across the body so the entire stock, receiver, grip and muzzle fit inside the vertical frame; do not shorten, crop or duplicate it. Translate the single olive head antenna into a practical sensor ornament, leaving a fully human face unobstructed; no robot faceplate, no Gundam V-fin. Keep recognizable olive forearm, hip, knee and ankle plates while the fitted open armor exposes collarbone, waist flanks and measured upper-thigh gaps, with opaque secure chest and pelvic coverage. Front-facing full-body portrait with head, both eyes, both feet, giant shoulder shield, backpack, cable and entire rifle inside generous margins. Pose otherwise freely chosen. No letters, insignia, model numbers or watermark. Face distinction: a clearly adult Middle Eastern woman in her early twenties with warm tan skin, a balanced heart-shaped face, upturned medium green eyes, an aquiline convex-bridge nose, bow-shaped upper lip, tapered chin and thick long brown hair in a side ponytail with side-swept bangs. Tall lean adult body with a long torso, full chest, straight hips and very long slender legs. She must not resemble Chuatury Panlunch or any canonical pilot, and must not resemble previous characters.
